description: One-shot due-diligence report for a Czech company. Fetches the aggregate ARES profile, Public Register record (statutory bodies), Trade Register (licenses), evaluates insolvency status (IR + CEÚ) and dissolution date, and returns a structured report with a green/yellow/red risk flag plus a Markdown summary suitable for chat display. Replaces 4–5 individual lookups with a single call.
name: ares_full_due_diligence
